name: Eleazar (son of Mahli)
title: Levite from the clan of Merari
summary: Eleazar was the son of Mahli in the Levitical clan of Merari. He died without sons and had only daughters, who were married to their cousins, the sons of Kish.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites
keyEvents.description: Eleazar, the son of Mahli, died without sons, and his daughters were married to the sons of Kish.
